notes.title: v0.1.6 - Box Storage & Employee Restocker
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, everyone 🍎[/p][p]
We’re happy to share the first peek at [b]Fruit Mart Simulator[/b], a relaxing shopkeeping game where you build up your own fruit store from the ground up. With every crate you unload and every customer you help, you'll shape your way to becoming a trusted name in town.[/p][p]Early development has focused on making the essentials feel right, and today we’re sharing some of the first key features we’ve implemented.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s fresh off the shelf:[/p][p][b]1. Box Storage System[/b]
Your fruits and goods are now stored in the new Box Storage system, making it easier to keep everything organized. This update improves access and visibility, so you can quickly find and restock items without digging through clutter.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652937/2f838321e00857be06d17b819fdd96913e34f5f4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]2. Hire a Restocker[/b]
Once you reach level 2, you’ll be able to hire an employee to help restock your display shelves automatically. This frees up your time to focus on customers and management, while your restocker quietly keeps the shop well-stocked in the background.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652937/621e5ef178894800d1f1c8da533a1604f24d5fd2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652937/755e4997921ea68ec3171d1d39217dd00c96d77c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That’s a wrap for our very first devlog for Fruit Mart Simulator! 🍎🍊[/p][p]We’re just getting started, but every update helps shape [i]Fruit Mart Simulator[/i] into a more polished and delightful experience. Thank you for following along with our journey. More juicy updates are coming soon![/p][p]We always open to all feedback and suggestions to make this game as mature as possible. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of the community.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers 🍓[/p]
